verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Beautiful and glorious
Your greatness is unsearchable
You’re the bright and morning star
Jesus, You outshine the brightest sun

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
King of kings and Lord of lords
You will reign forever
You’re the slain and risen Lamb
I will sing a new song

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
This is my beloved, this is my Friend
I’m going to love Him till the end of time
I’m going to see Him face to face, oh joy divine
This is my beloved

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You are glorious in holiness
Jesus, King of righteousness
Chief among ten thousand
Fairer than the sons of men
